description:
Assist a key account with a short-term assignment. Build an InfoPath form utilizing Nintex workflow to initiate a project request and manage project demand. Form will collect initial data, notify users of required action, and allow data to be reported on.
 Should be able to develop, test, and deploy the form within 4-5 weeks.
 
 Please note that we are not able to work with candidates on H1B Visas or candidates represented by third parties 
 Sharepoint Developer 3-5 years experience  
 InfoPath 2010 SharePoint 2010 Nintex workflow 

 Strong understanding of: (SharePoint) Content types (SharePoint) Document sets (SharePoint) Site  columns  (InfoPath) Views based on web part connections
